page_title: CAD 0-2 BET | Cadiz CF v Betis 09/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+3' Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
90+2' Juanmi (Cadiz) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
90' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Aitor Ruibal (Betis) replacing Marc Roca.
90' It will be a substitution. Sergi Altimira (Betis) is ready to enter the pitch as Pablo Fornals walks off.
89' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Hector Bellerin (Betis).
89' Flag up against Lucas Pires (Cadiz). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
88' Lucas Pires (Cadiz) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

87' Fali (Cadiz) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
86' Good work from Cadiz CF as they win a corner.
86' Sokratis (Betis) picks up an injury.
85' Rodri (Betis) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
82' Substitution. Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Robert Navarro walks off.
81' Rodri (Betis) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
79' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
78' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Nabil Fekir will be replaced by William Carvalho (Betis).
78' It's time for a substitution. Chimy Avila (Betis) comes on in place of Willian Jose.
76' The corner from Nabil Fekir (Betis) is intercepted by the defence.
74' Cadiz CF take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
73' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Rui Silva easily deals with the threat.
73' The resulting set piece from Cadiz CF is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

73' Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. The ball is out of play and Cadiz CF manage to earn a corner.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Abde Ezzalzouli leaves the pitch and Rodri (Betis) comes on.
69' Mauricio Pellegrino has decided to substitute Gonzalo Escalante and he is replaced by Alex Fernandez (Cadiz).
69' Here comes a substitution. Ruben Sobrino is given a rest as he is replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
69' Robert Navarro (Cadiz) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
65' Booking. Sokratis (Betis) receives a caution from the referee.
64' Nabil Fekir (Betis) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
59' Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
57' The linesman raises his flag. German Pezzella (Betis) is adjudged offside.
56' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle after Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Betis are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
52' Today's referee Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea rightly decides to book Juanmi (Cadiz) for his harsh tackle.
50' Pablo Fornals (Betis) will deliver the corner kick.
49' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
46' 0 - 2 Pablo Fornals (Betis) latched on to a sweet ball in the box and coolly slotted in near the left post.
46' The substitution is prepared. Juanmi (Cadiz) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ivan Alejo.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Hector Bellerin (Betis) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
45+1' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cadiz CF, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' Chance! Gonzalo Escalante (Cadiz) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but Rui Silva is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
43' Neat passing move from Cadiz CF in order to create new attacking opportunities.
39' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle. Robert Navarro (Cadiz) commits a foul after dangerous play.
38' The free kick from long range, taken by Cadiz CF, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
36' Iza Carcelen (Cadiz) sends a cross into the box, but Rui Silva comes off his line to gather the ball.
35' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
32' Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
31' Willian Jose (Betis) is quickest to the rebound and shoots towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
30' Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) brought his opponent down.
27' It looked like the long-range shot by Marc Roca (Betis) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the left post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time.

25' Chris Ramos (Cadiz) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Rui Silva. This effort really didn't trouble him.
24' Nabil Fekir (Betis) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

23' Nabil Fekir (Betis) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Conan Ledesma easily deals with the threat. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Betis.
21' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Lucas Pires (Cadiz), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
20' There's an opportunity for Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

19' Good clearance! Chris Ramos (Cadiz) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players. Cadiz CF get a corner.
16' A clumsy foul by Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) and Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle.
14' The foul by Marc Roca (Betis) was seen by Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
11' Nabil Fekir (Betis) takes the free-kick from mid-range but it's blocked by the defensive wall.
11' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Chris Ramos (Cadiz), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
9' Johnny (Betis) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea blows his whistle for an infringement.
8' Willian Jose (Betis) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
6' 0 - 1 Willian Jose (Betis) finds himself in a very promising position after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and fires the ball inside the right post!
5' Johnny (Betis) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post.
4' Betis players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Betis will kick-off.
Ricardo de Burgos Bengoetxea is introduced as the referee for today's match.
